registerModal.title: Register New Domain
registerModal.subtitle: Just attach a hearing sheet and AI implements it automatically
registerModal.useAnotherName: Please use a different domain name
registerModal.hearingContentHint: Text input or file attachment (either one is fine)
registerModal.hearingContentPlaceholder:
Describe what you want to assign to what, along with the goal and constraints.

Example:
Load warehouse items (~200) onto trucks (10 vehicles).
Goal: minimize the number of trucks used.

※ Using a hearing sheet gives more accurate results
registerModal.forceNewDomain: Force as a new domain (never try to fit into an existing domain)
registerModal.forceNewDomainHint: Use this when automatic classification incorrectly picks "add scenario to existing domain" or "generate scenario from base problem". Checking this always routes through Stage 2's full new-code generation (creating new converter.py/solver.py).
registerModal.generatingDomain: AI is generating the business domain...
registerModal.connectionUnstable: Connection is unstable. Processing continues on the server. Attempting to reconnect...
registerModal.runningFooterNote: Code generation may take a few minutes. Processing continues on the server even if you close this window, and will resume from where it left off when reopened.
registerModal.confirmationNeededHint: Automatic detection found some points worth confirming.
registerModal.confirmationExplanation: ⚠️ The generated result has points that need attention. Click "Cancel" to discard this attempt and start over. To proceed, click "Continue" — an AI agent directly fixes the generated files. If it hits an ambiguous point that needs a business decision, it will ask you right here (answer it and the agent keeps going, no new round needed). Once the agent's work is done, Gate2 is re-verified once and registration proceeds.
registerModal.confirmationExplanationLoopExhausted: ⚠️ The generated result has points that need attention. The AI agent's automatic fixes and the Gate2 re-check are already complete. Click "Cancel (discard work-in-progress files)" to discard this attempt and start over. If the remaining points are acceptable, click "Register as-is" to proceed.
registerModal.memoLabel: Answer / instructions (optional. If any point needs a business decision, write it here before continuing)
registerModal.memoPlaceholder: e.g. Prioritize department-fixing over surplus-capacity reduction / meetings with no department set can be skipped
registerModal.forceApply: Register as-is (remaining points are false positives)
registerModal.forceApplyHint: Use when you can tell from the AI agent's explanation that the remaining points are harmless false positives. Skips Gate2 re-verification and registers the current content as final.
registerModal.forceApplyBlockedNote: ⛔ "Register as-is" is unavailable because a Gate2 dynamic-verification finding (based on actually running the solver) is still outstanding. This is an objective fact that the implementation is broken, not something that can be waived. Cancel and fix it, or consult with the team.
registerModal.forceApplyBlockedHint: Disabled because a Gate2 dynamic-verification finding remains. This category of finding is non-negotiable and cannot be overridden.
registerModal.agentQuestionTitle: The AI agent has a question
registerModal.agentQuestionHint: This needs a business decision. Answer it and the agent will keep going without starting a new round.
registerModal.agentAnswerPlaceholder: Type your answer to the question
registerModal.registrationRolledBack: Registration did not complete (automatically rolled back)
registerModal.registrationRolledBackNote: Frontend type-checking failed, so all of this run's changes were rolled back. The domain was not registered. Please review the errors below.
registerModal.restartNote: Restart the backend and reload the frontend for the changes to take effect.
registerModal.gate2WarningsHint: Registration was not blocked, but the generated code may have issues. Please review it.
registerModal.extensionsZeroWarningBody: The extension_gaps apply process completed, but 0 functions were actually written to the destination files. The LLM output may not have returned in the expected format. The extension (separate from "Registered Scenarios" below) is likely not implemented. Please check the generated {{domainName}} solver/converter files directly.
registerModal.categorySummaryHeading: Breakdown of this round's findings, and what to check
registerModal.categoryGuidance_dynamicException: Includes a finding where the program actually crashed with an error while running. This needs a code fix from the dev side, not a review of your data or constraints.
registerModal.categoryGuidance_dynamicMismatch: Includes a finding where the actual solve result didn't match what was expected. This is an objective result from real data, so please review it carefully.
registerModal.categoryGuidance_requiredGap: Some required rule from your hearing sheet may not be implemented yet. Please compare the finding against your hearing sheet answers.
registerModal.categoryGuidance_missingInDslForSolver: Some field you provided may not be used in the actual calculation. Please check which of your hearing sheet items the field name in the finding corresponds to.
registerModal.categoryGuidance_unusedInSolver: Some field you provided may not be referenced by the actual calculation.
registerModal.categoryGuidance_bigM: This is about how multiple objectives are prioritized in the calculation. Please check whether the priority order and the numbers in the finding match your intent.
registerModal.categoryGuidance_absentValue: This is a calculation-logic finding about how candidates that weren't selected are handled.
